events.label: founding
events.text: Established by executive order of President Theodore Roosevelt as first federal wildlife refuge.

evidence.quote: Established by an executive order of President Theodore Roosevelt on March 14 , 1903
President Roosevelt signed an executive order that established Pelican Island as the first federal bird reservation

events.label: designation
events.text: Designated a National Historic Landmark by the Secretary of the Interior.

evidence.quote: Later in 1963 , Pelican Island was designated as a National Historic Landmark

events.label: expansion
events.text: Florida agreed to expand the refuge to nearly 5000 acres.

evidence.quote: In 1968 , Florida agreed to expand to include nearly 5000 acres

events.label: designation
events.text: Became the smallest wilderness area in the National Wilderness Preservation System.

evidence.quote: And then in 1970 , Pelican Island became the smallest wilderness area in the National Wilderness Preservation System

events.text: New public facilities opened and dedicated during the refuge centennial ceremonies.

evidence.quote: New public facilities were opened and dedicated on March 14 , 2003
